content: {"episode_id":"ep-05080","cpt":"93271","denial_carc":"CO-97","necessity_paragraph":"CPT 93271 (cardiac event monitoring) was performed for a patient with a history of paroxysmal atrial fibrillation (I48.0) and recurrent episodes of syncope (R55) that were not adequately captured by standard ambulatory monitoring.
